title: Collective rearrangement simulation
action: Implement a collective rearrangement simulation for 10^4 equal spherical particles (mean radius 1.0) with periodic boundary conditions, stopping when the mean overlap falls below 1e-4. Output the particle positions, radii, and pairs of touching particles.

title: Area density computation
action: Cut the packing by 40 equally spaced planes perpendicular to each Cartesian axis (X, Y, Z). For each plane compute the area density as the sum of cross-section areas of particles cut by that plane divided by the plane area. Store the three sequences of 40 area density values.

title: Statistical tests and results summary
action: Using the packing data and area densities, compute: packing density; coordination number; mean and standard deviation of area densities per axis; autocorrelation coefficients for lags 1-8 per axis; chi-square test statistic for homogeneity by dividing the packing (excluding surface layer) into 27 equal cubic subregions; means and variances of absolute relative projections (|x'|, |y'|, |z'|) of centre-to-centre lines between touching particles; sample variances of area densities per axis, and F-test statistics F_xy and F_yz. Write all computed quantities to simulation_summary.json.
description: Aggregate quantitative evaluation results from the packing analysis for scoring.
